|---|---|---|
| **Rheinufer AG** | Konrad-Adenauer-Ufer 41, 50668 (by the river, close to the main station and the old town) | 15 Oct: "Wartungsvertrag – Verlängerung" (maintenance contract renewal) |
| **Vorort Systeme KG** | Neusser Landstraße 384, 50769 (north of the centre, in Merkenich/Worringen, so a taxi ride) | 16–18 Oct: three entries titled "Rückruf Aachener Metallwerke" |
| **Dom Digital GmbH** | Unter Sachsenhausen 21, 50667 (central, near the cathedral) | Nothing recorded |

- **Best pick: Rheinufer AG.** It's the most central, and it had a contract renewal come up this week. I only saw the activity title, not its content, so I can't say whether the renewal is closed or still open. Check that with Sofia before you go.
- **Vorort Systeme KG:** The three callback entries are filed under Vorort but are titled "Aachener Metallwerke". The title and the company link disagree, so they may be mislinked. I wouldn't treat Vorort as a recent contact until that's cleared up.
- **Dom Digital GmbH:** It has no activity, no contacts and no deals, so a visit would be a cold one.
- **No other cities:** I also searched Bonn, Leverkusen, Düsseldorf and a few suburbs and found nothing.
- **Coverage:** The search only covers company and contact records that have a city filled in. A client with no address would be missed.

I can pull the Rheinufer renewal details or check who else knows people there. I haven't contacted anyone or changed any records.
